policy: Only photos legally publishable by rights verified CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, public-domain or photographer permission count for unrestricted public gallery; CC BY-NC research images held, not public.
note: Values are separate six-role field-teaching estimates, not percentages of total known photographs and not declarations of public release. Do not automatically promote species above 70% based on photo count.
